title: "Five-minute variable overlap"
format:
  html:
    page-layout: full
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
triggerR <- new.env()
source("R/read_data.R", local = triggerR)
if (!exists("trigger_5min")) trigger_5min <- triggerR$read_trigger_5min()
trigger_5min <- triggerR$drop_suspect(trigger_5min)
```

```{r}
pairwise_variable_overlap <- local({
  variables <- trigger_5min %>%
    distinct(origin, variable) %>%
    arrange(origin, variable) %>%
    mutate(id = row_number())

  observed <- trigger_5min %>%
    filter(!is.na(mean)) %>%
    distinct(userId, bucket_5min, origin, variable) %>%
    left_join(variables, by = c("origin", "variable"),
              relationship = "many-to-one")

  bucket <- observed %>%
    group_by(userId, bucket_5min) %>%
    group_indices()

  present <- Matrix::sparseMatrix(
    i = bucket, j = observed$id, x = 1,
    dims = c(max(c(0L, bucket)), nrow(variables))
  )

  overlap <- as.matrix(Matrix::crossprod(present))

  expand_grid(x = variables$id, y = variables$id) %>%
    transmute(
      origin_x = variables$origin[x],
      origin_y = variables$origin[y],
      variable_x = factor(variables$variable[x],
                          levels = unique(variables$variable)),
      variable_y = factor(variables$variable[y],
                          levels = rev(unique(variables$variable))),
      overlapping_buckets = overlap[cbind(x, y)],
      light_label = overlapping_buckets > .45 * max(c(1, overlap))
    )
})
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 22
#| fig-height: 16

p_overlap <- pairwise_variable_overlap %>%
  ggplot(aes(variable_x, variable_y, fill = overlapping_buckets)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = .35) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      label = scales::label_number(
        scale_cut = scales::cut_short_scale(), accuracy = .1
      )(overlapping_buckets),
      color = light_label
    ),
    fontface = "bold", size = 4.2
  ) +
  facet_grid(origin_y ~ origin_x, scales = "free", space = "free") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "C", direction = -1, transform = "sqrt",
    labels = scales::label_number(big.mark = ",")
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(`FALSE` = "black", `TRUE` = "white"),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Pairwise co-occurrence of variables in five-minute buckets",
    subtitle = "Same participant and UTC bucket; facet strips show variable origin",
    x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "Co-occurring\nbuckets"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.spacing = grid::unit(.3, "lines"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1, size = 10),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10)
  )
p_overlap
```

## Correlations

Correlations pool participants and time, without weighting by `n`.
Each pair uses shared buckets with non-missing means. These are descriptive
correlations, not within-participant estimates.

```{r}
correlations <- local({
  wide <- trigger_5min %>%
    select(userId, bucket_5min, origin, variable, mean)

  stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(
    wide[c("userId", "bucket_5min", "origin", "variable")]
  ))

  wide <- wide %>%
    pivot_wider(
      id_cols = c(userId, bucket_5min),
      names_from = c(origin, variable),
      names_sep = ":",
      values_from = mean
    ) %>%
    select(-userId, -bucket_5min) %>%
    select(order(names(.)))

  map_dfr(c("pearson", "spearman"), function(method) {
    cor(wide, use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = method) %>%
      as.data.frame() %>%
      rownames_to_column("measure_y") %>%
      pivot_longer(-measure_y, names_to = "measure_x", values_to = "r") %>%
      mutate(
        method = method,
        measure_x = factor(measure_x, levels = names(wide)),
        measure_y = factor(measure_y, levels = rev(names(wide)))
      )
  })
})
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 22
#| fig-height: 11

p_cor <- correlations %>%
  ggplot(aes(measure_x, measure_y, fill = r)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = .2) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      label = if_else(is.na(r), "", sprintf("%.2f", r)),
      color = abs(r) > .6
    ),
    size = 2.5
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ method, nrow = 1) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#B2182B", mid = "white", high = "#2166AC",
    limits = c(-1, 1), na.value = "grey90"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(`FALSE` = "black", `TRUE` = "white"),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "Correlation") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, size = 8),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
p_cor
```
